title: httptest.get
description: Retrieve web scenarios according to the given parameters.

groupids.description: Return only web scenarios that belong to the given host groups.

hostids.description: Return only web scenarios that belong to the given hosts.

httptestids.description: Return only web scenarios with the given IDs.

inherited.description: If set to true return only web scenarios inherited from a template.

monitored.description: If set to true return only enabled web scenarios that belong to monitored hosts.

templated.description: If set to true return only web scenarios that belong to templates.

templateids.description: Return only web scenarios that belong to the given templates.

expandName.description: Expand macros in the name of the web scenario.

expandStepName.description: Expand macros in the names of scenario steps.

evaltype.description: Rules for tag searching. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

operator.description: Possible operator types: 0 - (default) Like; 1 - Equal; 2 - Not like; 3 - Not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Not exists.

tags.description: Return only web scenarios with given tags. Exact match by tag and case-sensitive or case-insensitive search by tag value depending on operator value. Format: [{"tag": "", "value": "", "operator": ""}, ...]. An empty array returns all web scenarios.

selectHosts.description: Return the hosts that the web scenario belongs to as an array in the hosts property.

selectSteps.description: Return web scenario steps in the steps property. Supports count.

selectTags.description: Return the web scenario tags in the tags property.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: httptestid and name.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
